schema.description: Layered provenance schema: raw measurements are immutable, derived values are calibrated, provenance tracks transformations

transferability.recommendation: Calibration is PORTABLE (score: 99.95%). Reference backend ibm_fez offset transfers well to other backends.

recommendations.calibration_strategy: Use unified calibration across backends. Reference backend ibm_fez offset is portable.
recommendations.replicate_policy: Recommend 2 replicates per promoter-backend combination for stable calibration.
